title: GlossMark repository config
description: The repo-level glossmark.yaml: the ontology namespaces this repository owns and imports, prefix aliases, the views file, scanning options and the gate policy. Mirrors model.Config in internal/model/files.go, which decodes with KnownFields(true), so unknown keys are errors.

owns.description: Namespaces this repository owns, keyed by CURIE prefix. Each owned namespace has an ontology file (default ontology/<prefix>.gloss.yaml).

imports.description: Namespaces imported from elsewhere, keyed by CURIE prefix.

prefixes.description: Extra CURIE prefix → IRI base mappings (for example boundary namespaces) that are neither owned nor imported ontologies.

repo-iri.description: The repository's own IRI. A boundary prefix not declared under prefixes: expands to <repo-iri>boundaries/<prefix>/.

source-url.description: Template linking viewer paths to a code host, with {path} and {line}: https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/{path}#L{line}.

views.description: Path (relative to this file) of the views.yaml projections file. Default: ontology/views.yaml.

exclude.description: Globs of paths the scanner skips.

comment-styles.description: Extends the builtin comment-token table. Keys are a lower-case file extension including the dot (".foo"), an exact file basename ("crontab"), or a glob over the repository-relative path ("**/cron.d/*"; any key containing /, *, ? or [). The most specific key wins: a basename, then the longest matching glob, then an extension. Values are the comment tokens that may open an @gloss marker in such files: a line token ("#") or a block pair separated by a space ("<%-- --%>").

test-paths.description: Globs whose markers default to the verifies relation when relation inference runs. Default: common test layouts.

suggest.description: The repository's defaults for gloss suggest, and the precision auto-accept must meet (ADR 0024). Command-line flags override them.

auto-accept-precision.description: The precision auto-accepted (SOFT) proposals must reach. The conf threshold is derived from it: the lowest conf whose proposals at or above it were at least this precise on the calibration data (suggest.calibration, else the shipped calibration). When no conf reaches it, nothing is auto-accepted. Takes precedence over policy.soft-conf-threshold; when neither is set, 0.9.

min-conf.description: Default of gloss suggest --min-conf: the lowest conf that becomes a proposal.

labels.description: A labels file (tab-separated path, symbol or *, relation, target) that gloss suggest --calibrate scores against instead of the repository's own links. Relative to the repository root.

calibration.description: The repository's own measurement: per-basis counts written by gloss suggest --calibrate --write. When the file exists the auto-accept threshold is derived from it instead of the shipped calibration. Relative to the repository root.

stopwords.description: Words that never match a concept on their own, added to the built-in list of programming words (handler, manager, process, ...). An alias is never filtered.

links.description: Links from code anywhere in the repository to concepts, as a manifest's links: for its directory (docs/adr/0041-manifest-links.md): each entry maps a path glob (relative to the repository root) or a declaration symbol to concepts under one or more relations; a bare .Name resolves in the default-namespace of the matched file's own manifest. See manifest.schema.json#/$defs/link.

history.description: The repository's defaults for gloss history (ADR 0040). Command-line flags override them.

step.description: What one history step spans: every commit (merges excluded), the first-parent main line, or the commits between two namespace version bumps.

grammar.description: The @gloss grammar version the repository is written in (default 1). The tool refuses a grammar it does not support.

iri.description: An IRI base; CURIEs expand by concatenating the local name to it, so it normally ends in / or #.

glob.description: A slash-separated path glob; ** matches across directories.

tier.description: Ontology tier: core (the business ideal) or implementation (the concrete system).

file.description: The *.gloss.yaml ontology file, relative to the repo root. Default: ontology/<prefix>.gloss.yaml.

version.description: Optional repeat of the ontology file's version:, which is the namespace version; gloss check fails when they disagree (GM115) and warns when only this one is set (GM114).

owner.description: Team or actor that owns the namespace.

source.description: Where to fetch the ontology: a local path (directory or file), a git+ URL (git+https://..., git+ssh://...) or an https URL.

policy.description: The configurable gate policy (model.Policy). Omitted fields take the defaults from the design: hard-paths [ontology/**, **/.gloss.yaml, glossmark.yaml]; the SOFT conf threshold is derived from suggest.auto-accept-precision (ADR 0024).

soft-conf-threshold.description: A fixed conf threshold: proposed links at or above it are SOFT, below it HARD. Used only when suggest.auto-accept-precision is not set (it then takes precedence); with neither set, the threshold is derived from the default precision 0.9 (ADR 0024).

hard-paths.description: Globs whose changes are always HARD.

auto-accept-soft.description: When true, gloss accept --policy accepts SOFT proposals.

coverage-fail-under.description: Default for gloss coverage --fail-under: a percentage, or current to fail only when coverage falls below the base's (a ratchet).

criticality-gates.description: Minimum gate for a change that touches a concept or boundary at or above a criticality level (docs/GOVERNANCE.md). Default: critical → HARD.

waiver.description: Suppresses one finding until it expires (model.Waiver).

finding.description: The drift finding id or a concept CURIE.
